target_customer: Engineering teams building AI agents and RAG systems that need retrieval over their users' or company's app data
problem: Agents cannot use private data spread across productivity tools, email and document stores without custom connectors, syncing and indexing for each source.
business_model: Open-source core with hosted cloud tiers (free, $16/month Pro, $239/month Startup, custom Enterprise) and enterprise add-ons
product_category: Developer infrastructure: context retrieval layer for AI agents

founders.name: Lennert Jansen
founders.background_notes: YC page says he did AI research at Amazon and IBM and has worked with LLMs since 2020. Schools not named.

founders.name: Rauf Akdemir
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was a data platform engineer at fast-growing startups and a large enterprise, employers not named. The founders met at university about seven years before the page was written.

technical_complexity.rationale: Connectors to many SaaS sources, incremental sync, hybrid semantic plus keyword search and an API or MCP layer are standard but wide engineering work for a small team in 2025.

defensibility.rationale: The code is open source and connector breadth is replicable. The main protection is the integration surface and community adoption, which is modest against well funded search vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established. The GitHub repository was archived by its owner on 2026-08-29, but no source explains why.

market_need_then: Agent builders in 2025 needed access to private data across tools, and the founders framed Airweave as developer infrastructure for connectors, sync, indexing and a retrieval API, a gap enterprise search products for humans did not fill.

branding.domain_note: Uses airweave.ai. An unrelated Japanese bedding brand named Airweave exists and shares the name in search results.

identity.logo: not described by any source found
identity.visual_style: developer tool site with pricing tiers and docs
identity.voice_and_tone: technical and plain, positioned as infrastructure

branding.community_and_virality: GitHub repository shows about 6.5k stars and 816 forks on the archived page, which indicates developer interest.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found. Developer attention came through open source, while the name is shared with a well known bedding brand, which hurts search.

outcome_analysis: Airweave raised a $6M seed in July 2025 led by FCVC soon after its Spring 2025 batch, riding demand for agent context infrastructure and a popular open source repository. As of the sources found, the company site still sells hosted plans and no acquisition, shutdown or pivot is reported, yet the GitHub repository was archived by the owner on 2026-08-29 and the reason is not public, so the later trajectory is unknown.
notes: PitchBook lists $6.5M total raised, which conflicts with $6M. No dated competitor sources near the April 2025 launch were found, only later positioning comparisons, so the list is empty. The exact cause of the repository archive in August 2026 is not public, and it is unclear whether the company continues on a closed source basis.
